item.title: VIDEO | Announcing urban local body elections, Andhra Pradesh SEC Anil Chandra Punetha says, "Andhra Pradesh State Election Commission has taken a dec...
item.description:
VIDEO | Announcing urban local body elections, Andhra Pradesh SEC Anil Chandra Punetha says, "Andhra Pradesh State Election Commission has taken a decision to conduct elections to local bodies, both rural and urban. In urban local bodies, about 100, the election notification is being issued today, that is 14th of October, and this process, conduct of poll is on 28th of October, and counting of votes and declaration of results on 30th of October. With indirect elections, this entire process will be completed on 5th of November. For MPTCs and ZPTCs, the notification will be given on 19th of October, the counting of votes and declaration of results on 5th of November, and the indirect elections will be completed on 11th of November. The Gram Panchayat elections in Andhra Pradesh will be completed in three phases. Phase 1 will start on 13th November with notification, it will complete on declaration of results on 26th November, indirect elections will be completed on 26th November. Phase 2, 16th November notification, declaration of results 29th November, indirect elections 29th November. Phase 3, 19th November, declaration of results on 2nd December, and indirect elections also on 2nd December. So, the entire process we are starting today, and they will be completed on 2nd of December, 2026."

When asked about the Model Code of Conduct, he says, "The Model Code of Conduct, now I have announced the schedule of elections, it has come into effect from today, and we will be writing to the Chief Secretary and also to the concerned authorities for strict implementation of Model Code of Conduct. So that, the elections are conducted in a free and fair manner and nobody gets any kind of advantage."

#AndhraPradesh #UrbanLocalBodyElection

item.description:
VIDEO | Shimla, Himachal Pradesh: Tourism-dependent businesses along the Kalka-Shimla railway line in Himachal Pradesh are reporting losses after a landslide disrupted train services for several weeks.

The landslide occurred between Koti and Gumman railway stations in Solan district on August 29. Train services are currently restricted to the Shimla-Dharampur section, while the Dharampur-Kalka stretch remains suspended as restoration work continues.

Taxi operators say the reduced train services have severely affected their business, with no clear timeline for the resumption of normal operations.

VIDEO | Delhi: Cisco Chairman and CEO Chuck Robbins on Wednesday said any effort to slow down AI is unlikely to work, and that the focus should, instead, be on strengthening security and defences to keep up with the technology.

Amid global calls for pause in Artificial Intelligence and scientists warning about possible catastrophic outcomes for humanity from rogue AI, Robbins, in an interview with PTI, said, "I think we are going to be okay".

"I think the biggest thing...there is this whole debate about should we slow down AI or not. You are not going to slow it down. I mean, I just don't think that is going to happen," Robbins said.

VIDEO | Bihar boat capsize: RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav (@yadavtejashwi) says, "Look, this is an extremely heartbreaking and tragic incident. I received information about it last night, and I spoke with all the officials as well. Given the number of children who died when the boat capsized, I believe action must be taken to determine whose negligence led to this tragedy. First and foremost, we extend our heartfelt condolences to all the families who have lost their children, leaving mothers bereaved. Our party workers had also reached the spot yesterday. We have decided that, since we were in Delhi for the protest, we will go there to meet them, we will provide financial assistance, but the government should have impartial investigation, I would say that these families should receive three decimals of land. As you all must have seen, the accident occurred because the boat broke down and water entered it. However, until a concrete conclusion is reached, we need to investigate how the boat was operating at night and who was responsible for allowing it to do so. We will look into all these aspects and discuss the matter further."

item.title: VIDEO | Bihar boat capsize: Vaishali DM Varsha Singh says, "Look, a very tragic incident occurred yesterday, in which the bodies of a total of 13 chil...
item.description:
VIDEO | Bihar boat capsize: Vaishali DM Varsha Singh says, "Look, a very tragic incident occurred yesterday, in which the bodies of a total of 13 children were recovered, while six people could be rescued. We have constituted an inquiry committee to investigate the entire sequence of events, from the beginning of the incident until the rescue operation was completed, and determine whether there was any negligence at the administrative level. The committee will submit its report by tomorrow morning. Immediately after the incident yesterday, the administration responded promptly and ensured that the necessary medical assistance was provided through the hospital. We also called in the State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) team. However, the local people and local divers had already retrieved everyone from the water. In addition, we disbursed the benefits payable under the disaster relief protocols last night itself. Under the ex-gratia grant, an amount of ₹4 lakh is provided to the beneficiary for each deceased person. We handed over the cheques for this amount last night itself. Additionally, under the Kabir Antyeshti Yojana, ₹3,000 is provided for funeral expenses. This amount was also disbursed last night. Under the Chief Minister's Family Benefit Scheme, ₹20,000 is payable for each eligible beneficiary. We have initiated the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) process to transfer this amount to their bank accounts. The money will reach their accounts shortly. Furthermore, the Hon'ble Prime Minister has announced compensation of ₹2 lakh for each deceased person and ₹50,000 for each injured person. We have submitted the required data from our side for these payments as well, and the DBT transfer process has begun."

#Biharboatcapsize #Vaishali

item.title: Indian Embassy in Saudi Arabia (@IndianEmbRiyadh) posts, "This is in continuation of our detailed Advisory issued yesterday. In view of the current si...
item.description: Indian Embassy in Saudi Arabia (@IndianEmbRiyadh) posts, "This is in continuation of our detailed Advisory issued yesterday. In view of the current situation, all Indian nationals are advised to continue to follow local authorities’ instructions, stay indoors in case of aerial attack, and refrain from circulating videos or news related to ongoing events. 2 Indian nationals who were injured in the Riyadh airport attack on 10 October continue to be in ICU, while 1 has been shifted from ICU to HDU (High Dependency Unit). 4 more Indian nationals continue to receive medical care in normal ward, and 1 person was discharged from the hospital. Flight operations continue to remain suspended at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh. Flight operations at Dammam, Jeddah, and Medina continue, with some disruptions. Indian carriers (Air India, Air India Express, Akasa Air, and IndiGo Airlines) have suspended flights to and from Saudi Arabia until Oct 17, 2026. Saudia airlines continues to operate scheduled flights from Dammam, Jeddah, and Medina. Flynas is operating scheduled flights on the Dammam–Lucknow sector."

item.description:
STORY | Satellite internet selected as subject for discussion: Par panel chief Nishikant Dubey

A Parliamentary panel has selected satellite internet as one of the key subjects for a threadbare examination in the coming days, amid the ongoing row over Elon Musk's remarks on the delay in the government's approval of his company Starlink to launch the service in India.

Musk's Starlink, along with Eutelsat OneWeb and Jio Satellite, have applied for permission to start satellite internet service in the country.

Jio Satcom is Reliance Jio's satellite venture, while Eutelsat OneWeb is backed by Bharti, which runs the pan-India mobile and internet network, Airtel.

BJP MP Nishikant Dubey, who is the chairman of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Communications and Information Technology, said the panel has selected satellite internet as one of the subjects for close examination.
